acceptance.given: A governed Skill package and the frozen authoring policy are supplied to the local package validator.

oracle.expected: The validator reports a structured compliant result only when the standard and governed package declare primary responsibility, triggers, non-goals, I/O, dependencies, references, tests, evidence, and lifecycle boundaries; a package missing the I/O declaration is rejected with a rule identifier and repository-relative location.
forbidden: A package missing the I/O declaration is accepted.
The validator relies on headings alone without identifying the missing declaration and relative location.
Raw package content, timestamps, or environment secrets appear in the result.
oracle.observable: The validator's structured result contains the declared I/O requirement and, for a fixture with that declaration removed, a deterministic diagnostic naming the failed rule and relative path.

acceptance.then: The standard's I/O responsibility is represented in the policy and validator contract, and the targeted validation case distinguishes a complete declaration from a missing I/O declaration.
acceptance.when: Run the A01 package-validation test against a complete governed fixture and against the same fixture with its I/O declaration removed; evaluate the structured validator result during the test invocation phase, without assuming either outcome in advance.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_core.py::test_a01 with a governed fixture whose I/O declaration is removed; the assertion must fail if the validator accepts the fixture or omits the rule and repository-relative diagnostic.

affected_subjects: Skill authoring standard I/O declaration and lifecycle-boundary validation
slice_hint.behavior_change: Introduce the Package A standard and local validator contract so required I/O and lifecycle declarations are explicitly represented and missing declarations are rejected with structured, location-aware diagnostics.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted runtime state changes; rollback removes the new standard, policy, schemas, validator, and ADR/index declaration while preserving existing Skill and replay protocols.

slice_hint.state_transition: Unspecified or incomplete standard declaration -> validator inspection -> structured pass for complete declarations or rule-specific rejection for a missing I/O declaration.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The A01 selector verifies that complete and missing-I/O governed fixtures produce the distinct structured outcomes required by SM-A01, including a rule identifier and repository-relative diagnostic for rejection.
